title: A quasi-finite morphism of affine schemes is an open immersion into an affine scheme finite over the base (Stacks 03GU)
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] such that $X$ and $Y$ are affine and $f$ is quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Then there exist an affine scheme $Z$, an open immersion $j:Y\to Z$ [def-weil-open-immersion] and a finite morphism $\pi:Z\to X$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] with $f=\pi\circ j$. (Stacks Project, Morphisms, Lemma Tag 03GU, which is Algebra, Lemma Tag 00QB (lemma-quasi-finite-open-integral-closure) reformulated for schemes: for $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$, $Y=\operatorname{Spec}S$ with $R\to S$ of finite type and quasi-finite, $Z=\operatorname{Spec}S''$ for a finite $R$-subalgebra $S''$ of the integral closure of $R$ in $S$.)

mathlib_searches.query: quasi-finite morphism of affine schemes factors as open immersion followed by finite morphism
If R → S is a finite type quasi-finite ring map, then Spec S is an open subscheme of Spec S' for a finite R-algebra S' (Zariski main theorem, global affine form)
